sentences.text: Notidanodon was an extinct genus of cow shark.
The genus Notidanodon was recently split into two after the creation of the genus Xampylodon.
There are 37 recorded fossil occurrences of Notidanodon in the Paleobiology Database.
Notidanodon is classified in the class Chondrichthyes.
It belongs to the family Hexanchidae.
Only two Mesozoic species, Notidanodon pectinatus and Notidanodon lanceolatus, are currently attributed to the genus.
This animal lived from the Hauterivian to the Thanetian, between 132.6 and 56 million years ago.

Fossils date to the Jurassic and Cretaceous periods, with the earliest found in the Tithonian of New Zealand and the latest in the Maastrichtian of Antarctica. They have also been found in Africa and South America.
